decision: Choose one of up to 8 fully constructed, distinct Replace children; candidate 0 is the exact Balanced child
candidate_generation: Same legal target and repair executor as the current Balanced branch; deterministic private seeds; no objective evaluation before selection

prediction.parent_q90_objectives_at_mutation: usually unavailable after crossover; never used as inference input
prediction.candidate_input: constructed child and current population available before objective evaluation
prediction.selection: maximize exact 3D HV calculation on predicted objectives and current feasible population using frozen normalization and reference; tie or unsupported state selects Balanced
prediction.guarantee: Balanced inclusion is an abstention option, not a guaranteed HV floor

historical_data: ordinary mutation logs do not contain complete evaluated child encodings; the 384-state five-operator audit is not an eight-child offline test set

collection.additional_objective_evaluations: count every extra candidate evaluation separately from search budget
collection.split_unit: instance, with all candidates from a state kept together
collection.preprocessing: fit objective and feature scales on training instances only

offline_screen.data: new matched K8 panel; the old five-operator panel is exploratory only
offline_screen.primary_metric: mean actual selected-child HV contribution minus exact Balanced-child contribution over all held-out states
offline_screen.pass: mean gain positive, each validation instance positive, and at least one non-Balanced child chosen; do not adjust this rule on validation outcomes

supervised_training.architecture: batch-token Transformer followed by eight-candidate set Transformer
supervised_training.outputs: normalized CCP100 q90 cost, emission, makespan and feasibility
supervised_training.selection: mean ensemble prediction; feasibility probability at least 0.5; exact HV calculation on predicted objectives; first tie keeps Balanced
supervised_training.model_selection: minimum loss on the two predeclared validation instances; no threshold scan

ranker_v2.status: superseded before new validation execution by within-instance temporal screen
ranker_v2.reason_frozen_before_new_validation: absolute objective prediction selected Balanced in all 108 old validation states despite positive oracle gain; train direct candidate-minus-Balanced one-step HV gain
ranker_v2.old_validation_role: development diagnosis only; never used to admit ranker v2
ranker_v2.architecture: same batch-token and candidate-set Transformer; one scalar gain per candidate; Balanced output fixed to zero
ranker_v2.target: actual candidate one-step population HV contribution minus exact Balanced candidate contribution, divided by training-only RMS
ranker_v2.selection: argmax ensemble-mean predicted gain; candidate zero is fixed at zero and wins ties; no threshold scan
ranker_v2.pass: mean actual selected-minus-Balanced gain positive on each of train-S0-017 and train-S0-018, with at least one non-Balanced selection on each instance

within_instance_screen.split: within each trajectory, sort by generation/evaluation/event; first half trains and second half tests
within_instance_screen.preprocessing: fit separately per instance using its early-half states only
within_instance_screen.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; no late-half model selection or threshold
within_instance_screen.pass: late-half mean selected-minus-Balanced gain positive on both instances, with at least one late-half switch on each

final_hv_oracle_audit.role: development-only greedy one-step upper-bound audit; not deployable and not the locked final test
final_hv_oracle_audit.simple_score: negative equal-weight mean of pre-evaluation local nominal cost, emission and time deltas
final_hv_oracle_audit.oracle_score: largest exact one-step current-population HV contribution under the frozen CCP100 scenarios; exact ties choose Balanced
final_hv_oracle_audit.accounting: the selected child is one B400 evaluation; every other oracle pool evaluation is counted separately as diagnostic cost
final_hv_oracle_audit.pass: equal-instance oracle mean >=1 percent and every instance nonnegative
final_hv_oracle_audit.on_pass: collect a predeclared 25/50/100/200-instance small-ranker learning curve
final_hv_oracle_audit.on_failure: stop K8 prescreen; do not expand data or train another prescreen model

scale_learning_curve.status: admitted by final-HV oracle audit; frozen before generated-data outcomes
scale_learning_curve.instance_domain: S0 training OD pool; locked final test remains the disjoint test OD pool

states_per_trajectory.rule: collect every available exact-K8 decision after G10 up to 30; assign chronological tertiles after the trajectory completes

scale_learning_curve.validation_rule: same 20 untouched validation instances for all four learning-curve points
scale_learning_curve.architecture: width-16 one-layer batch-token plus candidate-set Transformer; Balanced output fixed zero
scale_learning_curve.loss: within-state magnitude-weighted pairwise logistic ranking; exact ties ignored
scale_learning_curve.model_selection: fixed final epoch and three-seed ensemble; no validation threshold, epoch, architecture or seed selection
scale_learning_curve.pass: size-200 mean net gain positive; at least 12 of 20 validation instances positive; positive log2-instance-count slope; size-200 gain exceeds size-25 gain
scale_learning_curve.on_pass: freeze size-200 ensemble for one paired B400 development search before PPO
scale_learning_curve.on_failure: stop K8 prescreen without collecting more data or tuning the ranker

scale_bounded_search.status: exploratory exception frozen after positive size-200 heldout mean and 12/20 positive validation instances; monotonic learning-curve gate remained failed
scale_bounded_search.model: fixed final-epoch size-200 three-seed ensemble; no retraining, threshold, epoch or checkpoint selection
scale_bounded_search.optimization: CCP100, confidence 0.9, pop20, B400; only the selected child is evaluated
scale_bounded_search.pass: equal-instance mean positive and every one of the three instance means positive, with at least one Transformer switch
scale_bounded_search.on_pass: admit one bounded PPO experiment while retaining the identical frozen no-PPO policy as an ablation
scale_bounded_search.on_failure: stop K8 ranker and do not open the locked final test

scale_review_audit.status: frozen after the three-instance bounded search passed and before reviewer checks
scale_review_audit.optimization_comparison: reuse exact Balanced and frozen Transformer runs; pair simple and greedy one-step oracle on the same initial populations, CCP100 scenarios, pop20 and B400
scale_review_audit.oracle_qualification: greedy immediate current-population HV oracle, not a mathematical upper bound on final trajectory HV

independent_re_evaluation.reference: one pooled all-method OOS normalized HV reference

scale_review_audit.model_freeze: checkpoint hashes, execution commit, training/validation instance lists, training seeds, loss and all CCP100/pop20/B400 configuration saved before audit

scale_ppo_training_and_selection.status: review audit passed; frozen before PPO outcomes
scale_ppo_training_and_selection.training_data: stored exact-K8 feedback from the 200 generated training instances only
scale_ppo_training_and_selection.validation_data: 20 generated validation instances receive no gradient and are used only for complete-search checkpoint selection
scale_ppo_training_and_selection.reward: stored exact selected-candidate one-step HV contribution minus exact Balanced-candidate contribution
scale_ppo_training_and_selection.checkpoint_selection: run CCP100/pop20/B400 once on every one of the 20 validation instances for updates 0/2/4/8; among updates 2/4/8 choose maximum mean paired final-HV percent versus supervised update0, then more positive instances, then earlier update
scale_ppo_training_and_selection.freeze: freeze both the original supervised size-200 Transformer and the selected nonzero-update Transformer-PPO for the formal experiment

development_search.checkpoint_selection: validation instances only; no development or final-test selection

ppo.admission: one frozen supervised model first completes the paired development search
ppo.reward: selected evaluated child's actual normalized population HV contribution
ppo.qualification: immediate reward does not guarantee final population HV gain; compare with the same pretrained checkpoint

development_gate: predeclared paired mean final-HV difference versus Balanced positive on each development instance; report all ten seeds and no retry with revised threshold

final_test.source_catalog: original instance catalog with test-side OD pool
final_test.rule: Freeze one model and all baselines before opening final-test outputs; evaluate each method once on the same instances, seeds and scenarios

prior_profile_screen.interpretation: Fixed Emission is a promising rule; instance-specific best is posthoc and offers a small, unconfirmed additional gain. The completed screen remains failed.
